name: kiro-allspark
description: Documents the connections between the repos of a multi-root Kiro workspace: defines each repo's role (frontend, backend, MVC monolith, worker), detects its connections (HTTP, SOAP, gRPC, Kafka/RabbitMQ queues, webhooks, S3) with a deterministic Python prescan (tree-sitter), validates them from both ends and renders them as an Obsidian graph and an interactive 3D cube: client, internal service and third parties.
